concepts.title: 次数与端行为
concepts.summary: 多项式的次数与首项系数决定两端方向；代入零求y截距。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 奇次两端相反，偶次两端相同；实零点最多为次数，偶重根可使不同截点个数为奇数。

en.title: Degree and end behaviour
en.summary: Degree and leading coefficient determine both tails; substitute zero for the y-intercept.

method.title: Method
method.body: Odd degrees have opposite tails and even degrees have matching tails. The number of distinct real zeros is at most the degree; even multiplicities can make the number of distinct intercepts odd.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 按降幂排列并补零；逐次除、乘、减；或逐列合成除法。

method.title: Method
method.body: Order by descending powers, insert zeros, then divide, multiply and subtract, or perform synthetic division.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 试常数项的因数，降次并继续分解；应用题检查每个尺寸为正。

method.title: Method
method.body: Test divisors of the constant term, reduce the degree and factor further. In applications require every dimension to be positive.

concepts.title: 零点、重数与图像
concepts.summary: 奇重根穿过x轴，偶重根接触后返回；符号由每个因子的正负决定。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 列截点、y截距和端行为，在每个相邻零点区间试值，再画光滑曲线。

en.title: Zeros, multiplicity and graphs
en.summary: An odd-multiplicity zero crosses the x-axis; an even-multiplicity zero touches and returns. Factor signs determine the sign of the function.

method.title: Method
method.body: List zeros, the y-intercept and end behaviour, test each interval between zeros, and sketch a smooth curve.

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先水平比例及反射，再竖直比例及反射，最后平移。

method.title: Method
method.body: Apply horizontal scaling/reflection, vertical scaling/reflection, then translations.

exercises.prompt: 选出正确说法。A 有些奇次多项式无x截点；B 偶次多项式总有偶数个x截点；C 所有奇次多项式至少有一个x截点；D 所有偶次多项式至少有一个x截点。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: 奇次多项式连续，且两端一正无穷一负无穷，必穿过x轴，所以C对、A错。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: B错：$y=x^2$ 只有一个不同的x截点。D错：$y=x^2+1>0$ 没有x截点。

en.prompt: Choose the true statement. A Some odd-degree polynomial functions have no x-intercepts. B Even-degree polynomial functions always have an even number of x-intercepts. C All odd-degree polynomial functions have at least one x-intercept. D All even-degree polynomial functions have at least one x-intercept.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: An odd-degree polynomial is continuous and has opposite infinite tails, so it must cross the x-axis. Thus C is true and A false.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: B is false: $y=x^2$ has one distinct x-intercept. D is false: $y=x^2+1>0$ has none.

en.prompt: Which statement is true for $P(x)=3x^3+4x^2+2x-9$? A The remainder on division by x+1 is 6. B x−1 is a factor. C P(3)=36. D $P(x)=(x+3)(3x^2-5x+17)+42$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: C: $P(3)=81+36+6-9=114\ne36$. D expands to $3x^3+4x^2+2x+93$, with the wrong constant. With that quotient the remainder should be −60.

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: 首项系数为1，整数零点必须整除常数12。12的正因数依次1、2、3、4、6、12，各加正负号。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: A漏3、6；B漏12；C漏12且多8；D准确列全候选。候选不表示都是真零点。

en.prompt: Which set should be tested to determine possible zeros of $x^4-2x^3-7x^2-8x+12$? A ±1,±2,±4,±12; B ±1,±2,±3,±4,±6; C ±1,±2,±3,±4,±6,±8; D ±1,±2,±3,±4,±6,±12.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: The leading coefficient is 1, so any integer zero must divide the constant 12. Its positive divisors are 1,2,3,4,6,12; include both signs.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: A omits 3,6; B omits 12; C omits 12 and includes 8; D gives the complete set. Candidates need not all be actual zeros.

en.prompt: Which is a factor of $2x^3-5x^2-9x+18$? A x−1; B x+2; C x+3; D x−6.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Test the corresponding values: $P(1)=2-5-9+18=6$; $P(-2)=-16-20+18+18=0$. Thus B is a factor.

exercises.prompt: 从 $y=x^3$ 变到 $y=3(\frac14(x-5))^3-2$，哪句正确？A 水平拉伸3倍、竖直拉伸1/4、左5上2；B 水平拉伸3倍、竖直拉伸1/4、右2下5；C 水平拉伸4倍、竖直拉伸3倍、右5下2；D 水平拉伸4倍、竖直拉伸3倍、左2上5。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: x−5表示右5，−2表示下2；没有负比例，所以无反射。符合选项C。

en.prompt: Which describes transforming $y=x^3$ into $y=3(\frac14(x-5))^3-2$? A Stretch horizontally by 3, vertically by 1/4, left 5 and up 2. B Stretch horizontally by 3, vertically by 1/4, right 2 and down 5. C Stretch horizontally by 4, vertically by 3, right 5 and down 2. D Stretch horizontally by 4, vertically by 3, left 2 and up 5.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Identify $a=3,b=1/4,h=5,k=-2$. Horizontal scale is $1/|b|=4$ and vertical scale is 3.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: x−5 means right 5 and −2 means down 2. Neither scale is negative, so there is no reflection. This matches C.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) By the zero-product property, x+4=0 or x−3=0: −4 (multiplicity 2), 3 (multiplicity 1). (b) Similarly, 3 and −1 both have multiplicity 2.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Factor as $4(x-2)(x+2)(x-5)(x+2)=4(x-2)(x+2)^2(x-5)$: real roots −2 (multiplicity 2), 2,5.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (d) $9(x^2-9)^2=9(x-3)^2(x+3)^2$, so −3 and 3 each have multiplicity 2. Substitution makes the original product zero for each listed root.

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (b) P(1)=0，除以x−1得 $x^2-12x-12$。所以有理系数分解为 $(x-1)(x^2-12x-12)$。解二次式得 $x=6\pm4\sqrt3$，实数完全分解为 $(x-1)(x-6-4\sqrt3)(x-6+4\sqrt3)$。保留原书的 $-13x^2$。

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) P(−1)=0. Divide by x+1 to get $x^2+3x+2=(x+1)(x+2)$, giving $(x+1)^2(x+2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) P(1)=0. Divide by x−1 to get $x^2-12x-12$. Thus the rational factorization is $(x-1)(x^2-12x-12)$. Its quadratic zeros are $6\pm4\sqrt3$, giving the real factorization $(x-1)(x-6-4\sqrt3)(x-6+4\sqrt3)$. The source term $-13x^2$ is retained.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Factor out −x: $-x(x^2-6x+9)=-x(x-3)^2$. (d) P(−1)=0. Divide by x+1 to get $x^2-4x+5=(x-2)^2+1$, which has no real linear factor. Thus $(x+1)(x^2-4x+5)$. Expanding each product checks the original.

en.answer: (a) $(x+1)^2(x+2)$; (b) $(x-1)(x^2-12x-12)$, with real linear factors shown above; (c) $-x(x-3)^2$; (d) $(x+1)(x^2-4x+5)$.

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (a) 分解 $(x+3)(x+2)(x-1)^2$。两端向上，在−3、−2处穿过，在1处接触，y截距6，所以对应B。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (b) $x(x-2)^2$：0处穿过，2处接触，三次正，左下右上，所以C。

en.prompt: Match each equation to the supplied graph A, B or C. Justify. (a) $y=x^4+3x^3-3x^2-7x+6$; (b) $y=x^3-4x^2+4x$; (c) $y=-2x^3+6x^2+2x-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) Factor as $(x+3)(x+2)(x-1)^2$. Both tails rise, crossings occur at −3,−2, a touch at 1, and the y-intercept is 6. This is B.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) $x(x-2)^2$ crosses at 0, touches at 2, and is a positive-leading cubic with left down/right up tails. This is C.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) $-2x^2(x-3)+2(x-3)=-2(x-3)(x-1)(x+1)$. It crosses at −1,1,3, has y-intercept −6, and left up/right down tails. This is A.

exercises.prompt: 用36 cm×20 cm的纸板做糖果盒，沿原图虚线折叠。(a) 用x表示盒的体积。(b) 若体积为512 cm³，盒子可能的整数尺寸是多少？

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: 这是带盖折叠图：水平方向为两个长面板及两个宽x的条，故 $2L+2x=36$，$L=18-x$。另一边扣去上、下各x，宽W=20−2x，高H=x。于是 $V=x(18-x)(20-2x)=2x^3-56x^2+360x$，$0<x<10$。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: $13+\sqrt{41}>10$ 不在实际域；$13-\sqrt{41}\approx6.597$ 虽在域内，却给非整数尺寸。x=2时长16、宽16、高2 cm，体积 $16\times16\times2=512$，是唯一整数组。

en.prompt: Candy boxes are made from 36 cm by 20 cm cardboard sheets folded along the dotted lines shown. (a) What is the volume as a function of x? (b) What are the possible whole-number dimensions if the volume is 512 cm³?

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: The folding net has a lid: horizontally it contains two length panels and two strips of width x, so $2L+2x=36$ and $L=18-x$. Removing top and bottom strips gives W=20−2x and H=x. Thus $V=x(18-x)(20-2x)=2x^3-56x^2+360x$, with $0<x<10$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: Set V=512: $x^3-28x^2+180x-256=0$. Since x=2 is a root, factor as $(x-2)(x^2-26x+128)=0$, giving $x=2,13\pm\sqrt{41}$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: $13+\sqrt{41}>10$ is outside the physical domain. $13-\sqrt{41}\approx6.597$ is in the domain but gives noninteger dimensions. At x=2, the dimensions are 16,16,2 cm and $16\times16\times2=512$, the only whole-number set.

exercises.prompt: (a) 对 $y=\frac13(x+3)^3-2$，求a、b、h、k，并描述相对 $y=x^3$ 的变换。(b) 求变换后定义域和值域。(c) 在同一坐标系画原函数与变换后的函数。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (a) $a=1/3,b=1,h=-3,k=-2$：竖直压缩到1/3，水平比例不变，左移3，下移2，无反射。

steps.title: 计算与说明
steps.body: (b) 三次多项式在每个实x有定义，且两端趋向相反无穷；所以定义域和值域均为 $\mathbb R$。

exercises.answer: (a) $(a,b,h,k)=(1/3,1,-3,-2)$；(b) 定义域和值域均为实数；(c) 见同轴图。

en.prompt: (a) Identify a,b,h,k in $y=\frac13(x+3)^3-2$ and describe how each transforms the base function $y=x^3$. (b) State the domain and range of the transformed function. (c) Sketch both functions on the same axes.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (a) $a=1/3,b=1,h=-3,k=-2$: vertical compression by 1/3, unchanged horizontal scale, left 3 and down 2, with no reflection.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (b) A cubic polynomial is defined for every real x and its tails approach opposite infinities, so domain and range are both $\mathbb R$.

steps.title: Calculate and explain
steps.body: (c) Map $(u,u^3)\mapsto(u-3,u^3/3-2)$. The origin maps to (−3,−2); (−1,−1) maps to (−4,−7/3); (1,1) to (−2,−5/3); (3,27) to (0,7). Plot these points and draw the two increasing cubics on the same axes.

en.answer: (a) $(a,b,h,k)=(1/3,1,-3,-2)$; (b) domain and range are all real numbers; (c) see the common-axis sketch.
